annotations.text:
Western Heat Dome: 2026-03-20 - The Peak

Absolute apex. Yuma 109F (broke 1954 record of 108F). Martinez Lake 112F (pending NWS validation). Phoenix earliest 105F on record. WWA: "virtually impossible" without climate change.
